title: Junior Visual Designer – Social Impact & Communication
description:
**Junior Visual Designer**  
*Turn Stories of Change Into Visuals People Remember.*

Good design can make a message clearer. Great design can make people feel something, understand something, and act on it. At Lighthouse Communities Foundation, we're looking for a **Junior Visual Designer** to join our Communications team and help bring the stories of our work with underserved youth to life — from social posts to campaign assets to event backdrops.

We are hiring for our office in **Aundh, Pune**.

**About Us**  
Lighthouse Communities Foundation works in skilling, employability, and livelihoods for underserved youth, bringing together Government, Corporates, NGOs, and Communities through a Public\-Private Partnership model. Our work is guided by four values: Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, and Courage.

**About the Role**  
As Junior Visual Designer, you'll work closely with the Communications team to turn briefs into clear, engaging, on\-brand visual communication — spanning both digital and print, giving you the chance to build a diverse portfolio on real campaigns and organizational initiatives.

**What You'll Create**

* **Digital:** Social media creatives, banners, and campaign assets across platforms and formats, consistent with Lighthouse's visual identity
* **Print \& Events:** Posters, standees, backdrops, invitations, certificates, signage, and stage branding — taking concepts from idea to production\-ready asset
* **Concept to Execution:** Translate creative briefs and stories into simple, engaging visual narratives, exploring multiple directions and incorporating feedback while working within brand guidelines
* **Collaboration \& Delivery:** Work with internal teams to understand communication needs, coordinate with printers and production partners, manage timelines, and keep design files organized

**What We're Looking For**

* Graduate preferred; 0–2 years of experience in graphic, visual, or communication design — fresh graduates with a strong portfolio encouraged to apply
* Practical working experience with **Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, and Canva** (non\-negotiable — your portfolio must demonstrate this)
* Good to have: Adobe InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro, basic motion graphics, short\-form video, or AI\-powered design tools
* Strong understanding of typography, colour, composition, layout, visual hierarchy, and both digital and print design
* Strong proficiency in English, plus at least one of Hindi, Marathi, Odia, or Telugu
* Curious about *why* a design works, comfortable taking feedback as part of the creative process, and able to balance creativity with deadlines and brand guidelines

**Why Join Us**  
Your designs won't disappear into a generic marketing campaign — they'll help tell real stories of young people finding their first opportunity, learners building skills, and communities moving towards sustainable livelihoods. You'll get exposure to campaigns, events, and organizational storytelling while building a portfolio with genuine social impact, alongside a team that values Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, and Courage.

**Position Details**

* **Role:** Junior Visual Designer
* **Location:** Aundh, Pune
* **Experience:** 0–2 years
* **Employment Type:** Full\-time

**How to Apply**  
Email your resume to **careers@lighthousecommunities.org**, mentioning the role in the subject line. **Portfolio submission is mandatory** — please have your portfolio link ready, showing range across social, campaign, print, and event work, with individual contributions noted for any team projects.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Learn more about Lighthouse Communities Foundation: https://lighthousecommunities.org

About Masama Studios

**Masama Studios** is an established custom apparel and merchandise business that has successfully completed **2,000\+ orders since its inception in 2021**.

Having built a strong foundation in custom apparel, merchandise and creative products, we are now expanding into a **dedicated media and creative division**.

As part of this expansion, we are building a team of creative professionals who understand the evolving standards of the branding, design, social media and digital marketing industry.

We are looking for individuals who are not just good at using design software, but who understand **branding, aesthetics, communication and how creative work contributes to a business.**

About the Role

We are looking for a **Graphic Designer \& Brand Creative Specialist** who can take ownership of the visual requirements of our clients and our growing media division.

The role will involve working across **brand identity, logo design, social media, advertising creatives, corporate communication and digital campaigns.**

You will work on a variety of brands and industries, giving you the opportunity to build diverse creative work and contribute to the development of brands from the ground up.

* Work across different visual styles and industries

* Social media design

title: User Experience Designer
description:
**India, Pune**
---------------


**Digital Technology \& Research, Engineering \& Design, Manufacturing**
------------------------------------------------------------------------

 **About SLB**


SLB is a global technology company driving innovation in the energy industry. We combine science, engineering, data, and digital technology to address complex technical and operational challenges.


Our digital products support sophisticated, high\-impact work across the energy ecosystem. Designers collaborate with software engineers, scientists, domain experts, and product leaders to make complex systems understandable, efficient, and dependable.

  

**About the role**


We are looking for an analytical, systems\-oriented product designer who enjoys solving complex technical problems.


You will take ownership of the experience for significant product areas, working alongside another product designer and a cross\-functional team of product managers, engineers, and domain experts. You will also collaborate with designers across SLB when work connects with other products, platforms, or shared experiences.


You will simplify intricate workflows, organize complex information, and create coherent experiences across enterprise applications and connected digital ecosystems.

  

This role is about more than creating polished interfaces. It requires understanding users, systems, data, technology, and business needs—and balancing them to make sound product decisions.

  

We value the quality of your thinking, judgment, collaboration, and work—not simply the number of years you have spent in the industry.

  

**What you’ll do**

  

* Lead experience design for significant product areas, from understanding the problem through delivery and continued improvement.


* Shape new experiences and evolve established products while navigating legacy systems, technical constraints, and existing user expectations.


* Understand complex workflows, user roles, permissions, data relationships, and cross\-product dependencies.


* Translate user, business, stakeholder, and technical needs into clear experience models and workflows.


* Create information architectures, wireframes, prototypes, interaction designs, and detailed interface specifications.


* Plan and conduct appropriate user research and usability testing, translating findings into actionable improvements.


* Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, domain experts, and other designers.


* Use and contribute to design systems to create consistent, accessible, and scalable experiences.


* Communicate design reasoning clearly and explain decisions and trade\-offs using evidence.


* Facilitate conversations that align multidisciplinary teams around user needs and experience outcomes.


* Track usability issues and improve products using research, feedback, product data, and technical insights.


* Contribute to the practices, quality, and culture of the wider design community at SLB.

  



**How we work**


We value rigorous design thinking combined with practical judgment. Enterprise product development often involves ambiguity, competing priorities, mature platforms, technical constraints, and varying levels of access to users.

  

Our designers identify the activities that will have the greatest impact, advocate for what is essential, and adapt their approach to keep teams learning and moving forward. They know when to challenge constraints, when to work within them, and how to maintain a clear experience vision throughout delivery.

  

We expect designers to be curious, open, motivated, and collaborative. They invite feedback, respond to critique constructively, and remain accountable for their decisions. They can lead independently without working in isolation.

  

**What we’re looking for**


* Approximately 6\+ years of product or UX design experience, with evidence of sound judgment and independent ownership.


* Experience designing complex B2B, enterprise, technical, scientific, industrial, or workflow\-intensive applications.


* Strong systems thinking, including the ability to identify relationships, dependencies, patterns, and downstream consequences.


* Strong analytical problem\-solving skills and comfort working with ambiguity and incomplete information.


* Deep knowledge of interaction design, information architecture, user research, usability, prototyping, and human\-centred design.


* Ability to determine which design activities are needed based on the problem, available evidence, risks, and delivery constraints.


* Ability to understand technical concepts and collaborate effectively with engineers and subject\-matter experts.


* Strong visual and interface design skills supported by clear product and interaction\-design reasoning.


* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder\-management skills.


* Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy while collaborating closely with another designer and the wider product team.


* A curious, motivated, and receptive approach to giving and receiving feedback.

That's possible because of software like ours. And this also shows what software quality means to us.

This role will play a key part in shaping a modern, scalable, and intuitive user experience across the digital manufacturing ecosystem, ensuring consistency and workflow alignment between MLM, Inspection Flow, and the broader Metrolog Suite.
